headline: Nvidia unveils next-gen AI chip, shares rise 4%
summary: Nvidia announced its next-generation AI accelerator at a hardware event, with analysts citing strong early demand signals. The stock closed up 4% following the announcement.

headline: Nvidia supplier reports minor shipment delays
summary: A key Nvidia component supplier reported minor shipment delays due to a logistics issue, with no confirmed impact on Nvidia's own production schedule so far.

headline: Bank of Israel holds interest rate at 4.5%
summary: The Bank of Israel's monetary committee voted to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.5%, citing stable inflation figures.
